params.body:
The site is only built in the repository (`site/build`, regenerated by `site/src/pages.py`), with nowhere to publish it. This makes it deployable on Netlify as it stands.

- **`netlify.toml`:** publish `site/build`, no build command, since the pages are committed already built.
  - A rewrite serves clean paths (`/services` serves `services.html`); an existing file still wins.
  - Three plain security headers: `nosniff`, a referrer policy, and same-origin framing.
- **README:** a short "Publishing" section.

After merge, link `abovebeyond-ai/bextrust` to a Netlify site. Every merge to main is then live.
